title: Pool slot clears fd before returning it to caller (double-close protection)
description: crypto2dev_pool_acquire: when leasing a slot fd, sets pool->slots[i].fd = -1 before releasing the lock (line 319). This means cleanup() iterating over slots under the lock cannot close a fd that has already been handed to a caller — eliminates the double-close race. A contributor might remove this 'redundant' clearing to simplify the code, but it is load-bearing for the cleanup race.
